aiTitle: Built with AI, directed by a human
aiIntro: This site was built together with Claude (Anthropic), in Claude Code. Who did what:

roles.what: Intent, content and decisions: what goes in, what stays out, which path to take. Nothing shipped without his review.
Architecture and solution proposals, the code, the tests and the checks in a real browser.
Every architecture decision became an ADR, and every change a small commit with recorded co-authorship.

reviews: Hosting: Manuel swapped GitHub Pages for Azure Static Web Apps with Azure Pipelines; Claude recorded the decision (ADR-0009) and adapted the build.
Numbers: the wireframe said “20+ years”, and Claude pointed out that the CV didn't back it up. Manuel added his Delphi years (since 2006), and the experience is now computed at build time.
Images: Claude flagged that old games are still copyrighted and that one photo showed a game on screen; Manuel chose to blur the screen.
Curation: out of nine track photos, Manuel kept four, and swapped one after hearing a second opinion.
usageNote: Almost all of it (99 %) is context re-read from cache, not new text: the AI re-reads the project at every step.
history: See the full commit history on GitHub
